$comment: Parameters for the SIMPLIFIED prepayment-fee estimate (lib/mortgage/prepaymentFee.ts), from the Banking Order (Early Repayment of Housing Loans), 2002, consolidated to 2015.

operationalFee.note: s. 3(1): operational fee of up to ₪60. s. 9(b) lets the Supervisor index it to CPI by notice in Reshumot.

timeDiscounts.note: s. 8(b): discount on the capitalization fee, 20% from 3 to 5 years since origination, 30% from 5 years. Complementary loans (s. 8(a)) get a different schedule, which we don't model.

noNoticeFeeRate.note: s. 3(2): if notice was under ten days, a fee of one tenth of a percent of the amount repaid.
